prompt:
PURPOSE: menu card illustration for the compute package, the GPU server nodes installed in the pod's rack row.
SUBJECT: one 42U server rack in straight front elevation with the front door removed so the equipment is visible: a matte-black rack frame with vertical mounting rails, standing on slim leveling feet. Inside, eight identical dense GPU server nodes, each about 4U tall, stacked in a tight vertical column with equal small gaps. Each node has a dark-graphite faceplate with fine horizontal air-intake slots, two small front handles, and a thin vertical cobalt status bar at its left edge. Leave a short empty rail space at the top and bottom of the rack so it clearly reads as a rack, not a solid block.
ACCENTS: cobalt status bars only. No flow arrows.
COMPOSITION: centered rack, about 32% of the frame width and about 76% of the frame height. 4:3 frame.

STYLE — PODOS technical menu-illustration family (apply exactly; identical across every card)
Clean orthographic technical illustration in the manner of an engineering elevation drawing, produced as a premium product-menu card image.
PROJECTION: strict orthographic straight-on view. Zero perspective: no camera angle, no vanishing points, no foreshortening, no isometric or three-quarter rotation. All parallel edges stay parallel; horizontal edges are perfectly horizontal.
BACKGROUND: uniform porcelain white (#F7F8FA) covered by a faint cobalt blueprint grid of hairline-thin lines (major squares about one tenth of the image width, with fainter minor subdivisions). The grid is very light, roughly 8% opacity, and fades slightly toward the image edges. No other background element: no floor plane, no horizon, no room, no walls, no landscape, no sky.
EQUIPMENT RENDER: matte black to dark graphite surfaces (#111317 to #2A2E35) with soft matte shading, no gloss, no mirror reflections. Panel seams, vents, louvers, fasteners, handles, rails and internal detail are drawn as thin light-gray construction lines (#9AA3AD) and slightly lighter graphite faces. Small mechanical detail is crisp and believable, like a manufacturer's specification drawing.
FLOW GRAPHICS: cobalt blue (#2563EB) for primary / supply / power / incoming paths; cyan (#22D3EE) for secondary / return / data / exhaust paths. Paths are clean straight lines with right-angle bends and small solid triangular arrowheads, flat color, no glow, no gradient, no neon. Use green (#22C55E) only as a small enabled / online indicator dot or bar, and only where the subject description explicitly asks for it.
GROUNDING: one soft, restrained, slightly blurred shadow directly beneath the equipment on the porcelain surface. Subtle, low contrast, no long cast shadows.
COMPOSITION: exactly one concept per image, centered, fully inside the frame, never cropped, with an empty margin of about 12% of the frame on every side. Keep the whole subject group compact and readable at card size.
PROPORTION SYSTEM (keep identical across the family): a standard 42U server rack is drawn about 1 unit wide and 2.6 units tall on slim leveling feet; floor-standing support cabinets (CDU, UPS, switchgear, CRAC) share the same 2.6-unit height or a clean half height; the PODOS pod is a long low enclosure about 3.5 units long and 1 unit tall with softly rounded end caps, a low raised roof-panel array along the top edge, six equal flat side panels separated by thin seams, and a black skid base frame with small leveling feet.
MOOD: flat, precise, diagrammatic, quiet, premium engineering documentation.
EXCLUDE: text, letters, numbers, labels, dimension callouts, logos, wordmarks, watermarks, people, hands, environment, sky, floor tiles, isometric or three-quarter angles, perspective, photorealistic stock-photo rendering, dramatic lighting, lens effects, sci-fi glow, neon, purple or pink tones, orange, duplicate subjects, clutter, cropped edges.
